Name: Love Football: Aoki Senshi-tachi no Kiseki
Overview: The soccer game with original new system called “player perspective soccer”. This player-oriented soccer game is different from the conventional “TV-oriented” soccer games, and has a high sense of presence, power, and impersonation, and “you can strongly experience the feeling of actually playing soccer.” The camera position is placed behind the player. The system, which overlooks the whole from the pitch, is well-received by those who have actually played soccer as “actually very close”. The tension of facing the enemy at close range, the exhilaration of aiming and shooting, and the feeling of running into the space and receiving a pass. Unexperienced with amazing graphics made possible by the next-generation hardware “Xbox 360”, You can enjoy thrilling soccer.
